name: Ink Masjid
summary: A flowing ink silhouette gathers into a mosque dome, with a warm tapering minaret beside it.
why: Broad asymmetric forms and tapering ends suggest a few confident brush gestures. A pointed dome, open doorway, and slender minaret keep the building recognizable. The lower sweep gives the composition a gentle sense of movement without depicting writing.
risk: The organic dome feels expressive rather than architectural. Its fine upper tip becomes quieter at the smallest icon size, while the mosque body stays visible.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque that feels drawn by hand and quietly expressive.

palette.name: INK MASJID / SLATE TEAL + IVORY + COPPER
